title: Clean Python Function Implementation
description: Guides the LLM to write modular, type-hinted, and error-handled Python code.
template: Write a Python function to [describe specific task]. The function must accept [list parameters with types] and return [return type and description]. Include type hints, a Google-style docstring, robust input validation for [edge cases], and handle [specific exceptions]. Provide two runnable test examples showing typical and edge case outputs.

title: Code Debugging & Optimization
description: Structured format for diagnosing bugs and proposing optimized patches.
template:
Analyze the following [language] snippet: 
```[language]
[paste code here]
```
Identify the root cause of [describe unexpected behavior / error message]. Explain why the bug occurs in 2-3 bullet points, provide the corrected code snippet, and explain the time/space complexity before and after the fix.

title: First-Principles Concept Explanation
description: Explains complex ideas to a specified audience level with intuitive analogies.
template: Explain the concept of [technical topic, e.g., Transformer Self-Attention] to a [target audience, e.g., 2nd-year CS undergraduate]. Structure the response into: 1. High-level intuition with a real-world analogy, 2. Step-by-step mathematical/architectural breakdown, 3. Practical application in modern AI, and 4. Common misconceptions. Keep the total length between 350-500 words.

title: Research Paper / Document Extraction
description: Extracts methodologies, findings, and limitations from academic papers.
template: Summarize the key findings of [research paper title / topic]. Organize the summary into four exact sections: 1. Core Problem & Objective, 2. Proposed Methodology / Architecture, 3. Key Quantitative Results (metrics, benchmarks), and 4. Stated Limitations. Use bullet points and maintain an objective, academic tone. Word limit: 300 words.

title: Executive Project Status Update
description: Constructs a concise, actionable email update for senior leadership.
template: Draft a formal status update email to [Stakeholder, e.g., VP of Engineering] regarding [Project Name]. Highlight: 1. Major milestones achieved this week, 2. Key blockers requiring executive escalation ([describe blocker]), and 3. Next week's priority deliverables with deadlines. Maintain a concise, direct, and professional tone. Total length under 250 words.

title: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) Plan
description: Generates a complete EDA strategy for tabular or time-series datasets.
template: Create a structured Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) roadmap in Python (pandas, seaborn) for a dataset with columns: [list main columns] aiming to predict/analyze [target variable]. Specify: 1. Data cleaning & missing value strategies, 2. Univariate and bivariate distributions to plot, 3. Feature engineering ideas, and 4. Baseline modeling suggestions.
